site.name: klub-404
site.description: Neither agency nor incubator. A venture studio operating from Cairo and Amsterdam, building products, companies, and experiences that solve problems worth solving.

hero.tagline: Bringing together strategy, creativity and technology to build high-end digital products for early-stage startups.

features.heading: How we work
features.body: We understand the constraints of the early market. Our process is designed to maximize your runway while sharpening your product's competitive edge.

items.title: From Ideation to MVP with Speed
items.body: We move from a concept to a functional, market-ready product in weeks, not months.

items.title: AI-Integrated Architecture
items.body: We use AI-assisted development and intelligent agents from day one to speed up the building process and refine the final output.

items.title: Lean Economics
items.body: Our workflows are built to keep your team small and your impact large, using smart automation to handle the repetitive while you focus on the vision.

about.heading: How We Build
about.body: Our process is designed for clarity and speed. We don't just build features; we solve problems.

steps.title: Find the real problem.
steps.desc: We spend our energy on diagnosis. If we cannot articulate exactly why a problem is worth solving—and for whom—we do not move. We build only what matters.

steps.title: AI-powered workflows.
steps.desc: AI is not a tool we layer on top; it is part of the architecture from day one. Whether it is intelligent agents, generative features, AI-assisted development, or automated workflows it fundamentally changes the build surface and the economics of your product. We use AI to speed up the building process and sharpen the final result.

steps.title: Ship. Then stay.
steps.desc: Shipping is not the end—it is the beginning of the interesting part. We stay inside the problem after launch. We grow with you.
